text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Diagnostic result: "Damage: Extensive"... 
it seems. I determine the cause to be an 
error.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Simultaneously with an unidentifiable 
surge of emotion, I confirmed logs showing 
an unprompted increase in output.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Prioritized personal feelings and 
disregarded Master's instructions. ...In 
other words, an "erroneous action."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
During the examination, they recommended 
that I rest for a while. However, I wish 
to return to training immediately—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
――...Purging personal opinions. It appears 
an error has occurred in my thought 
circuits once again.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In light of recurring errors, I 
recommend... executing an extended leave.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's get plenty of rest.
Yeah, let's get some proper rest.

...Still, you want to make a quick 
comeback, right?

...Still, you want to get back right away, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In light of recurring errors, I 
recommend... executing an extended leave.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's get plenty of rest.
Yeah, let's get some proper rest.

...Still, you want to make a quick 
comeback, right?

...Still, you want to get back right away, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative... Applying patch during rest 
period. Eliminating error and attempting 
reboot.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Please wait until operation resumes.

Afterward, taking plenty of time... she 
was somehow able to make her comeback.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes... however, heightened emotional 
levels confirmed. At this rate, there is a 
risk of another error occurring—
choice_data_list:
Let's put that fighting spirit to good 
use.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Fighting spirit... So this is not... an 
error, is it?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Order acknowledged. Re-evaluating status. 
Status 'Fighting Spirit'... shifting to 
maximum utilization.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Executing maximum utilization... Heading 
to the training course with "fighting 
spirit" at max output—!
(CRASH-BASH-CLATTERRR!)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
F-Failure to watch forward... Collided 
with medical equipment... Further 
injury... detected...

Her eager feelings only ran her in 
circles, and her injury ended up getting 
worse...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Calculating requirements for maximum 
utilization. ...Please apply the taping, 
Master.

To match Mihono Bourbon's motivation, I 
carefully applied taping to her—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Phew... No worsening of injury observed. I 
judge that the return date can be moved 
up.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Master. It's all thanks to 
this taping.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"It feels just like running together with 
Master. ...Strangely enough, strength 
wells up inside me."

Exercising carefully to avoid aggravating 
the injury after that, she made a swift 
comeback!
